user.description: The system user to run the powerdebug command as.

modes.description: List of output modes to enable. Valid items: 'regulator', 'sensor', 'clock'. Corresponds to -r, -s, -c flags.

verbose.description: Enable verbose mode (-v) to show detailed information.

ticktime.description: Set the ticktime to specified value in milliseconds. Corresponds to -t flag.

dump_once.description: Read and list information only once and exit. Corresponds to -d flag.

log_path.description: The file path where the output of powerdebug will be redirected.
